title: Helm Chart Manifest
description: Defines Helm charts to mirror from upstream chart repositories.

entries.description: List of Helm charts to manage.

url.description: Chart repository URL or direct .tgz download URL.

frozen.description: When true, the entry cannot be built, edited, or deleted.

storage.description: Name of the storage backend holding this version's artifact bytes. Absent means "default" — the backend defined by storage_backend/storage_path/bucket/region — and is correct for every artifact uploaded before named backends existed. It is not a placement rule: storage_by_type decides where the next write goes, this records where an already-written artifact is.
